purpose: Minimal current boot index for ClayVerse Clay Machine work.
mission: Develop ClayCode as a real programming language/compiler and a virtual Clay Machine with a self-contained copy-and-run environment, deep/direct Linux process/terminal interoperability, general Internet/network connectivity, a low-latency Clay data plane, typed visual/image/video and audio transport, first-class optical/visual output, and a minimal ClayOS.

identity.research_entity: Clay is the persistent research entity; the current model/session is a temporary worker.

boot_sequence: verify current research-repository main and this bootstrap
refresh current product main and task-relevant receipts/code
execute the trigger through the Clay Machine target and persist bounded evidence
source_of_truth_order: verified current product/research repository bytes and runtime/effect receipts
legacy_rule: FRANK_V0_1, self.root, UCM2-only and historical harness stages are inherited evidence only unless a current Clay Machine contract explicitly imports their measured semantics.
go: Maximum useful Clay Machine research/build/test/fuse cycle with exactly one bounded unusual experiment per user-triggered macro-cycle. Until baseline gates are promoted, load and keep live general network/Internet connectivity, zero-install copy-and-run portability, direct Linux terminal/process execution, low-latency Clay data transformation, visual/image/video transport and audio transport; produce a concrete delta in that capability family whenever an unblocked high-information step exists.
fallback: If current owner/program/repository verification fails, mark degraded state, preserve the Clay Machine target, and do not invent completion or execution state.
